description: This file contains the implementation of the PersonService interface in the OpenMRS project, including methods for managing persons, relationships, attributes, and merge logs.

classes.name: PersonServiceImpl
classes.description: Default implementation of the PersonService interface, providing core functionalities for person, relationship, attribute, and merge log management within OpenMRS.
